_note: Hand-verified issuers for executive orders whose date cannot tell which Governor signed them: an order dated on an inauguration day, when both the outgoing and incoming Governor can sign. validate_ga_executive_orders.py refuses to commit such an order until it is listed here. Each entry: "<order number>": {"execId": "exec:..." (a confirmed Governor in ga-executive-seats.json), "_note": "how it was verified, e.g. the signature or letterhead on the PDF"}. An entry here also overrides the date for any other order. See scripts/lib/ga_governors.py.
